response: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) can be useful in differentiating unresponsive wakefulness syndrome (UWS) from minimally conscious state (MCS) patients. According to research, a-tDCS could be useful in identifying residual connectivity markers in clinically-defined UWS patients, who may lack purposeful behavior as a result of a motor-output failure. This suggests that tDCS may help in distinguishing between UWS and MCS patients by detecting subtle differences in brain activity.
